items.note: S1.1 states Lemma lem:scalar-motifs exactly (y_S+=x_S for arbitrary scratch; stage1/inverse/stage3 gives (-Y_a,X_a) with scratch restored) and the substeps follow the proof: net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, intersection-based coefficients cancelled by side wires, then the three-stage composition. The specific coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 are only described qualitatively, and h=100 and the wire counts are not given.

S1.2 states the frame assignment, the edge change D_vD_u^{-1}, commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate and that a route applies only its endpoint operator, matching 804-825. The formula D_out S D_in^{-1} and the route sign ε_w are not written out. It is an infer step with no sub-derivation.

S1.3 has nondegenerate nested labels, residual dimension equal to the dimension change, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing by h, as in Lemma lem:motif-residuals. It omits the ambient space F^{⊗3}, the triple indicator construction, L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L and the ratios L/N=100/539, 101/539.

S1.4 gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m and endpoint difference I_m, and S2.1/S2.1.4 give the frames Φ_M and the shear H<-H+D on every role, all correct. The defining matrices (P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at sources X_a) and the N rank-one source exceptions are never stated, so how the identity and the rank sum arise is missing.

S1.5 gives one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c<W_c m, and C^{⊗m} on every role. It does not define the phase frames C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{q_U})H^{⊗m} or give s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and it drops the source and sink diagonal corrections that the paper needs before C^{⊗m} holds on the X_a->Y_a route (1225-1227, 1297-1310).

S1 and S1.6 state s_b<W_b m, s_c<W_c m, τ=σ=1-2^{-50} and s/W<m^τ, as in the paper. The reasons are absent from every claim: L<N/2, the deficits η_b, η_c, and log m<20. The bound 20·2^{-50} appears only in S1.6's quote.

The plan uses cyclic row splitting into W streams and 'linear-cost updates of the later group' and cites controlled-shifts/stream-scans pages. It never states the lemmas' content (O(V) digit operations, controlled update y->y+a mod q^b with b^{O(1)} offset preparation).

S2.1.1 states the E_1ΠE_2 factorization with invertible lower triangular factors and a ones, and S2.1.2 states the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V), both exact. The elimination proof and the three-step implementation of each pivot (D+=H, swap, D=H-D) are not given, so these are statements, not derivations.

The plan follows the proof of prop:power-interchange: cyclic split into W role streams, edges by matrix shears with recursive interchanges, shear H<-H+D on every role, three-shear interchange, s calls on V/W, depth-first parking stack, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), F_k=O(e^τ). The statement leaves out the hypothesis that the row field length is divisible by W^k and the width e=m^k of radix-q digits.

S2 states the O(Vu^τ) bound for u-bit chunks, and S2.4 cites zero-row padding and base-m pieces. It omits the key construction, taking ρ=O(log e) high digits of the chunks as the row field (1660-1690), and the padding of binary ranges to [q^e] (1721-1734).

The plan follows 1867-1940. Conjugation by P_M puts kernels on slots, giving one child C^{⊗f} per residual vector. Gaussian elimination gives a fixed number of row additions, there are s_c forward children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z^{⊗f}C^{⊗f}Z^{⊗f} is asserted in S3.1.3 without its formula.

The plan follows the proof. Eight conditional additions flip the parity and restore w, applied as cyclic shifts. There are twenty excluded values per guard, giving δ_bad<=80(f-1)2^{-K}. Since T_0S_0^{-1} permutes only B, a radix sort repairs it, and the full time bound is given in S3.2.4. The simplified O(V(L^τ+1)) in S3.2 holds only under the family hypotheses, which the plan does not state.

The row split u=Wg+w, child volume V/W, the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) with leaves e<d^β, and summation over base-m pieces to O(d^{λ'}) are present and correct. Two parts of the unrolling are missing: the overhead bound K<=e^{c/β} giving O(e^λ) with a=s/W<=m^σ<m^λ, and the leaf bound e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}. The condition on λ' (max{λ,σ+β(1-σ)}<λ') is also not stated.

S3 with S3.4/S3.5 states the layer on up to d chunks in O(Vd^{λ'}) with one truncation, error <√2·2^{-p}, and Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉=o(p) guard bits, and the substeps follow the proof's structure. K=⌊d^c⌋ and the exponent conditions are missing, and the guard-width derivation (operation-depth bound and the count against C_0 d^{C_1}) is only asserted.

Character cancellation via the shift giving y^{rj_0}=-1, decimation in frequency with bit-reversed storage, the layout L by prefix moves and at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, per-round layer cost, error √2·ℓ·2^{-p}, and the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1} all match the paper's proofs.

S4.3 matches Lemma lem:signed-ring-product: evaluation at 2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, centered residues, reduction mod y^r+1, O(rp log(rp)). The separation bound |h_j|<B_0/2 and the returned Q_p(fg/r) are not stated.

S4 states M_r=(f*g)/T, the error √2·M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p} and the cost, and S4.4/S4.5 follow the proof: retain the LB order, signed-packed products, opposite transform, scale by M, contraction error propagation. The normalization identity F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) is implicit.

S5/S5.1 give P_sF_s=2^{2α²}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions, error <p² and time O(tp^{3/2+δ}α), and S6.5 gives the tensor form RF_s=2^γB_0QF_tA. The hypotheses (gcd(s,t)=1, θ>p/α⁴) and the definitions of P_s, P_t are missing. S5.2 also misattributes the d² factor to each axis.

S5.3 gives the chirp a and QF_t u = ā·(a*(ā·u))/T. S5.4 gives the cancellation with its reason (RF^+R=F^+ and permutations commuting with pointwise products), and S6.5.3 gives the conjugation. All are correct, but each is a single infer step rather than a derivation.

The exponents, the sizes b, p=6b, d, K, Tp=Θ(n), and the primes with S>T/2 are stated correctly. η=1/(4d), α, γ, the range T∈[4n/b,8n/b) with t_i∈{r/2,r}, and the inequality α⁴θ_i>p needed by resampling are missing. S6.1 says only 'θ_i>η'.

Φ:x->∏x_i^{μ_i} as a convolution-preserving isomorphism, triangular prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, axis reversal and cost O(Tpd²(1+ℓ^τ)) follow the paper. μ_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i is never defined, and the triangular coordinate formula b_i=a_i+μ_i Σ_{j<i}a_jP_j (mod s_i), on which the shift implementation rests, is missing.

S6.4 correctly states that the ζ^k twist with ζ=e^{πi/r} turns length-r cyclic convolution into convolution mod y^r+1, so d-axis cyclic convolution is ring convolution on d-1 axes between twist and untwist. The twist error terms are not mentioned.

The source transform as expansion, chirp transform via complex convolution, compression and 2^γ scaling with exact counterpart RF_s, the opposite procedure by conjugation, and the six steps (Φ, two transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Φ^{-1}, carries) all match 4415-4534. The input digit scaling 2^{-b-2} is implicit.

E_s=9·2^γTL, the (3E_s+2) opposite-transform error, the final bound 448b·2^{-b+γ}<=448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, and carries with k_j<2^{2b} are correct. The ring-convolution (5TL) and chirp (8TL) error steps that produce E_s, the bound E_w=S(3E_s+2), and the use of γ<=b/4 are missing.

The exponents, the minimum margin 2^{-181}=2κ, log-power absorption and O(n(log n)^{1-κ}) are correct. The seven normalized cost terms and the identity of the minimal margin g_2=εc(1-τ) are not listed. The paper's justification of each row and of setup and exceptional sorting as o(V), and the schoolbook cutoff, are not shown.
S0 says the bound disproves the n log n optimality conjecture in this model but gives no content: no eventual lower-bound formulation and no liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0.

errors.says: the endpoint operator on every role is C^{⊗m}
errors.paper: The raw route X_a->Y_a applies C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) and C elsewhere; C^{⊗m} on every role holds only after the source and sink diagonal corrections Z_{a,k}, i^{27k} and undoing the signed exchange (1225-1227, 1297-1314)

errors.says: exposing and restoring each axis by adjacent chunk interchanges costs O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ))
errors.paper: One axis needs O(d) adjacent interchanges, each O(Tp(1+ℓ^τ)); O(d^2) interchanges and O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)) is the total for all axes

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. It runs from the bank-exchange network, frames and labels (S1) through the matrix-shear interchange recurrence (S2) and the phase-frame butterfly layer (S3) to transforms, convolution, resampling, the CRT and exact recovery (S4-S6), and then the exponent bookkeeping (S7). It thins out at the rank-saving core. The plan states s<Wm and τ=1-2^{-50}, but it never gives the projection matrices, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, or the ratio L/N<1/2 that makes the deficit positive. The layer recurrence's unrolling and the guard-width count are also only asserted.

steps.note: S1.1 states the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, but h=100, the indexing by triples in T^3, N=C(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are absent. Since the required size data are missing, this is the conservative verdict.
S1.2: an invertible frame per vertex, D_vD_u^{-1} on edges, the common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, and a route applying only its endpoint operator, so intermediate frames are free.
S1.3: nondegenerate labels, every edge nested, and only central 3->4 edges decreasing, each losing h. S1 identifies m as the label-space dimension. F^{⊗3} itself is not named.
The plan says the labels turn an edge's cost into a dimension change, but it never states that P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, and it never mentions the N rank-one source exceptions.
S1.4 gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, but the budget Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are absent, and L_b is never defined.
s<Wm is asserted, but L/N=100/539 or 101/539 <1/2 and the deficit N-2L>0 are never stated. A deficit appears only inside S1.5's quote.
S1.4 and S2.1.4 state that the endpoint matrices differ by I_m, so the bit network with frames Φ_M applies H<-H+D on every role, including scratch roles.
E_1ΠE_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per rank-a shear, and the number of recursive calls equal to the edge-rank sum s.
There are children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^τ). The source of τ (η>20·2^{-50}, log m<20) appears only in S1.6's quote, not in a claim.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the frame mechanism, the labels, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50} (C2, C3, C7, C8, C9). The counting at the heart of the saving is thin. The plan never states rank equals dimension change via projections (with the N source exceptions), the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, or L/N<1/2, so s<Wm is asserted rather than explained. The network's size data (h=100, N, m=h^3) are also absent.
